census.title: 2020 Population Census, Basic Complete Tabulation on Population and Households, table 1-1
census.population: All persons, both sexes, all nationalities; never male-only, households, 2015 population or former municipality totals.

methods.binding: Own nondeprecated P429 with check digit, unique 5-digit census code, matching prefecture and native/ja name (municipal suffix normalization only, explicit suffixes must agree; ward suffix permitted), P31 present, item point within 25km as a conservative conflict screen. No district joins. P429 establishes the code binding; distance is not asserted to be polygon containment.
methods.holds: Missing captures, codes, name/prefecture/point conflicts, dissolved entities and post-2020 Hamamatsu wards held. No guessed equivalent bindings. Identity holds change only with v4 continuity and a guarded reviewed decision_only event.
methods.updates: 2020 count and year; equal counts receive year only; already equal stays unchanged. No other scalar changes.

retry_build.title: jp_pop_v5x_build_2
retry_build.method: Identical build_1 decision rules; sequential wbgetentities batches <=50 with >=5-second intervals and increasing error backoff. All retry response bodies and SHA-256 metadata retained in responses/. Untargeted compact ledger lines preserved byte-for-byte.
